segments.text: Welcome to Kiro Labs, Employee number four-oh-four.
Yes. That's your actual employee number. HR says it was the next one in the system.
Thirty seconds after you badged in, production returned HTTP 404. Everything is down. Coincidence? Probably.
Our pipeline has five stages and all five just broke. You have fifteen minutes to prove your employee number is a coincidence and not a prophecy.
No pressure. But the entire office is watching the leaderboard.
Employee four-oh-four just fixed a four-oh-four. I knew you had it in you.
Welcome to Kiro Labs. Let's build something together.
The pipeline's still returning 404. The betting pool says you'll get it next time.
Try again. We don't give up here.
